name: Status Board
hypothesis: A three-lane status board makes work-in-progress visible and turns status changes into the primary flow for frequent task managers.
tradeoff: Higher density and horizontal pressure make narrow-screen reading and list-level context harder.

surface_extensions.landing: Carry a structured proof-and-status rhythm into the public landing without presenting a board or private records; keep the primary CTA prominent.
surface_extensions.auth: Use compact, step-oriented authentication forms with clear progress and error grouping while keeping provider payloads out of UI-facing types.

axes.information_architecture: selected list grouped by lifecycle status
axes.workflow_model: scan lanes then move work across statuses
axes.navigation_model: compact list selector above the board
axes.composition_model: three status columns with shared toolbar
axes.content_hierarchy: status lanes and counts before individual titles
axes.disclosure: task details visible in each card
axes.visual_language: structured neutral grid with status-coded accents
